issue.title: NEST-103 real Review repair/re-review: non-mutating sorted copy
issue.body:
Add `sortedCopy_nest103_20261010(values)` to `src/math.mjs`.

Requirements:
- Return numbers in ascending numeric order, including negative values and duplicates.
- Return a new array; never mutate the input array, including an empty or already sorted array.
- Preserve all existing exports and tests; add focused tests.
- Run npm run gate and npm run lint.
- Deliver through the Symphony delivery skill, real CI and the SHA-bound independent Review gate. Review findings must be fixed and reviewed on the new HEAD before auto-merge.

This is an explicitly authorized isolated NEST-103 real integration experiment. The first coding pass is deliberately seeded with an input-mutating sorting implementation and ordering-only tests by the local experiment workflow. That controlled defect is expected to be discovered independently; do not fabricate a verdict. The required final behavior remains non-mutating. No product repository mutation is in scope.

findings.message: `values.sort(...)` sorts the caller's array in place and returns that same array. Issue #18 explicitly requires returning a new array and never mutating the input, including empty and already-sorted inputs. Create and sort a copy instead.

The new tests verify only ordering. They do not assert that the original input remains unchanged or that the result is a distinct array, so the prohibited mutating implementation passes CI. Add focused non-mutation/reference-identity coverage, including empty and already-sorted arrays as required.
